audio_url.description: The URL of the audio or video file to transcribe, or a data URI.

audio_start_from.description: Timestamp in milliseconds at which to begin transcription.

audio_end_at.description: Timestamp in milliseconds at which to stop transcription.

language_detection.description: Whether to automatically detect the language.

fallback_language.description: Fallback language when detection is uncertain.

code_switching.description: Whether to detect switching between languages.

localization.description: Regional language variants to use when rendering text.

keyterms_prompt.description: Words or phrases to prioritize during transcription.

disfluencies.description: Whether to include filler words such as um and uh.

speaker_labels.description: Whether to identify speakers in the transcript.

min_speakers_expected.description: Minimum number of speakers to identify.

max_speakers_expected.description: Maximum number of speakers to identify.

multichannel.description: Whether to transcribe each audio channel separately.

content_safety_confidence.description: Content safety confidence threshold from 25 to 100.

iab_categories.description: Whether to classify topics using IAB categories.

speech_threshold.description: Minimum fraction of speech required for transcription.

redact_pii.description: Whether to redact personally identifiable information.

redact_pii_audio.description: Whether to generate an audio file with spoken PII redacted.

redact_pii_audio_quality.description: Format of the redacted audio file.

return_redacted_no_speech_audio.description: Whether to return redacted audio when no speech is detected.

override_audio_redaction_method.description: Replace redacted speech with silence instead of a beep.

redact_pii_return_unredacted.description: Whether to include unredacted fields alongside the redacted transcript.

redact_static_entities.description: User-defined terms to redact, grouped by label.
